name: Barkskin

header.Components: V, S, M (a handful of bark)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Willing touched creature; Bonus Action; one-hour AC floor 17, not an AC bonus and not Concentration.

rules.text: Until the spell ends, the target’s skin assumes a bark-like appearance, and the target has an Armor Class of 17 if its AC is lower than that.
